title: python-project toolsets
description: Describes tool selections and their configurations.

tool_selections.description: The selected toolsets for each function.

task_requirements.description: The Poe tasks each function must provide, keyed by function. The selected package supplies them, and so must any alternative to it.

packages.description: What the commands know about each package, keyed by package name.

functions.description: The functions a package can fulfill.

dottedPath.description: A dotted key path into pyproject.toml, such as tool.ruff.lint.select.

settings.description: Values keyed by dotted path. A list adds its entries; any other value sets the key.

task.description: A Poe task: a plain command or a sequence. No shell, script, or expr tasks, which run arbitrary code and are harder to audit.

functions.description: The functions the package can fill.

specifier.description: PEP 440 version constraint, e.g. ">=9.1.1": the oldest version the baseline was verified with. Raise it only when the config needs a newer feature, not on every release. A locked version outside it is reported VERSION. Without one, `uv add --dev` picks the latest and the project's uv.lock pins it.

config_file.description: Its [tool.*] tables, in assets/pyproject/. Absent when the package is not configured in pyproject.toml.

dev_dependency.description: false when the package is not added to the dev group.

build_backend.description: The build backend a project should use.

tasks.description: Poe tasks the package supplies, keyed by task name and written to [tool.poe.tasks].

add_if_missing.description: Keys the config file seeds once. After that, the project's value is never compared.

remove_if_present.description: Superseded keys, each with the reason. Reported OBSOLETE and removed on --write.

conflicting_settings.description: Keys that clash with this package, each with what to do. Reported CONFLICT and never changed: they need moving by hand.

adds_to.description: Rule lists a project may add entries to. Only the baseline's entries are checked. A trailing `*` matches any key.

relaxes.description: Lists whose entries turn checks off. A project's extra entries are reported RELAXED for review. A trailing `*` matches any key.

typing_modes.description: Settings per typing mode. A key or entry another mode sets, and the current mode does not, is reported EXTRA and removed.
